Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, wherein the system further comprises means for managing the investment portfolio by adding and removing investments from the investment portfolio.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in performing the step of adding an investment to the investment portfolio and further including means for use in removing an investment from the investment portfolio.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in performing the step of removing an investment from the investment portfolio.
